nodes.name: Prefiltro
nodes.notes: Drops promotions, social, spam, mass newsletters and job-alert senders, and trims quoted threads, so the model only reads mail that could matter.

nodes.name: Parsear
nodes.notes: The model only extracts facts (topic, does it ask for a reply). Urgency is decided here with fixed rules, and a keyword fallback covers model failures.

nodes.name: Aviso Telegram
nodes.notes: Only urgent mail reaches the phone: a recruiter asking for availability, an assessment, a client question.

nodes.name: Ollama clasificar
nodes.notes: Sends the request built in "Armar prompt" as is: model, JSON schema, temperature 0, context size. If Ollama is down, "Parsear" falls back to keyword rules so nothing important is lost.
